title: 2025 Highlights: Engaging Moments in Business Central Events
summary: A community contributor reflects on 2025 engagements across Business Central events, podcasts, and a growing technical blog covering AL Development, sharing key topics like AI, workflows, and open source tools with the community.
key_points: Attended multiple community events including Directions 2025, DUG New England, DUG Canada East, and Dynamics Con 2025
Participated in several podcasts covering AI, workflow, AL Development, and diversity in the Dynamics space
Aardvark Labs blog grew from a goal of 500 to over 2200 page views per month through community engagement
Plans for 2026 include expanded blog content, AL Development video series, and a new Dynamics Con event

quotes.text: We talked about AI, Workflow, AL Development, and even the amazing community we are all a part of.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the key technical topics and community focus that define recent Business Central discussions and engagement

quotes.text: Your feedback, criticism, and suggestions help drive what we do here, and I thank you.
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes the collaborative nature of the Business Central community and how feedback shapes content and resources
